description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Local HL/Thirdfy snapshots for id= plus live day/week/month windows. Informational only — not investment advice. Returns JSON local Hyperliquid or Thirdfy snapshots for the id plus the live day, week, and month windows.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

days.description: How many days of stored snapshots to include. Format: positive integer. Example: 7. Default: 7.

id.description: Hyperliquid wallet or vault, or a Thirdfy slug, same id as bot_sheet. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a slug. Example: 0x85ecf584f25db6f146718b86d493e33c5af72052. Required.

name: bot_history
title: Trading bot 7-day history ($0.01)
